source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

scope: A 4:3 Wenckebach teaching example, not a clinical AV-node electrophysiological model.
rule: P waves are equally spaced. PR increases beat by beat with decreasing increments; the fourth P is blocked, then the sequence resets. Mechanical events retain their delay relative to electrical events.
constraints: Only 4:3 conduction with the original grouped constraints. The final mechanical offset plus 120 ms must be strictly less than the atrial period. QT uses the atrial period as a conservative lower interval bound, without beatwise adaptation.
verification: Checks exact event times/window boundaries, checkpoints, twelve-lead recovery, delayed pressure/runoff, atomic event budgets, cancellation and times near long.MaxValue, plus native data/pixels in both demos.
unimplemented: Other Wenckebach ratios and variable sequences remain unimplemented.
Third-degree AV block and escape origins/morphologies remain unimplemented.
Atrial flutter, atrial fibrillation, ventricular flutter and ventricular fibrillation remain unimplemented.
